result.title: SpeeDiff: Scalable Pixel-Anchored End-to-End Latent Diffusion Model
result.comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026. 29 pages, 17 figures, 14 tables
result.summary: We present Scalable Pixel-anchored End-to-end Diffusion (SpeeDiff), a latent diffusion method that jointly trains the VAE and the diffusion model from scratch. In principle, joint training allows the diffusion loss gradient to directly guide the VAE encoder, encouraging the formation of a generation-friendly latent space and potentially yielding faster convergence than the conventional two-stage approach with a pretrained frozen VAE. However, a naive end-to-end implementation severely degrades performance, as unrestricted backpropagation of the diffusion loss leads to latent space collapse. Our main technical contribution is a simple yet effective Tweedie Pixel Reconstruction (TPR) loss, which provides additional pixel-level feedback by decoding a predicted clean latent from an intermediate noisy state using Tweedie's formula, thereby alleviating collapse. Furthermore, our method enables jointly scaling a fully transformer-based architecture and enhances representation alignment within the end-to-end framework. Our SpeeDiff-XL model achieves over 140x and 61x faster training compared to Vanilla SiT and REPA, respectively, while attaining an FID of 1.50 without guidance on ImageNet 256x256 generation. With a more efficient 32x compressed VAE, our model further reaches an FID of 1.53 without guidance on ImageNet 512x512 generation.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SpeeDiff，从零联合训练 VAE 与扩散模型的 latent diffusion 方法，用 Tweedie 像素重建损失从中途噪声态解码预测的干净 latent，以缓解潜空间坍缩，并实现训练加速与高保真生成。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「扩散梯度直通编码器导致潜空间坍缩」的诊断与像素级重建锚定，可能为 LVR 中视觉细节在 latent 状态中丢失、以及用像素反馈约束表示提供可核查线索；但研究对象是图像生成，迁移到多模态推理需核查。
